Forecast Discussion

The early-fall nor'easter that walloped the New England coast is exiting with a whimper today. High pressure centered in the Ohio Valley drifts eastward and will eventually give us a warmer SW flow. It will be centered over the Carolina coast Friday.

We have lots of sun, cool nights in the valleys, and progressively warmer temperatures overall through Friday. We'll have increasing cloudiness Friday afternoon and Friday night. A shower is possible later Friday night.

A front approaching from the NW arrives Saturday and stalls nearby Saturday and Sunday. Showers overtake our region Saturday afternoon through Sunday morning, with thunder possible Saturday afternoon and Saturday night. Rain continues into Sunday, tapering off Sunday afternoon. Sunday will be considerably cooler under the clouds and rain.

A Canadian front passes through Sunday night, leading to a windy, cooler, but dry Monday. Cooler weather continues through the first half of next week.
